candidates.anchorage_tie: Applied Atomics is headquartered in Anchorage, Alaska; Kellie is an Alaskan entrepreneur based in Alaska per his personal site and the Alaska World Affairs Council program recap.
candidates.decision_what: Applied Atomics secured an exclusive license from BWX Technologies (NYSE: BWXT) for commercialization rights to the mPower small modular reactor, a 195-MWe land-based pressurized water reactor, with exclusive rights for commercial development and deployment of land-based nuclear facilities in the US, Canada, and elsewhere. BWXT retains mPower IP ownership and exclusive manufacturing rights plus royalties. Applied Atomics will re-engage the NRC to resume mPower design certification (a program BWXT suspended in 2017) and develop site-specific engineering for initial commercial deployments. The mPower technology is targeted at AI data center power supply as its primary initial market.
candidates.binary_owned: Kellie chose to license the mPower design from BWXT rather than continue Applied Atomics' own proprietary reactor design or license an alternative SMR technology, committing to re-engage NRC certification for a program suspended in 2017 and accepting royalty obligations and BWXT manufacturing exclusivity in exchange for exclusive commercialization rights.
candidates.ak_consequence: Nuclear energy / power infrastructure. Applied Atomics has publicly identified Alaskan industrial targets including the Richardson Highway corridor (potentially displacing Golden Valley Electric coal plants), Chugach Electric co-location, and the Donlin Gold project. A successful SMR deployment in Alaska would be the first nuclear plant in state history and could reorient the industrial power market for extractive and tech-sector customers. Multi-year timeline (NRC re-engagement, siting, construction).

corroborating_sources.note: Paywalled; covers Ananym Capital activist-investor angle
Establishes Anchorage context and prior Kellie quote

subject_quotes.verbatim: BWXT spent a decade working to design mPower. Our job is to complete its development then design and deploy the first optimized, vertically integrated SMR power plant.
subject_quotes.context: Kellie statement in the Applied Atomics press release via GlobeNewswire, June 17, 2026.

subject_quotes.verbatim: We think this is building the Falcon 9 of nuclear power plants.
subject_quotes.context: Kellie at the Launch Alaska Tech Deployment Track pitch event Sept 16, 2025, per Alaska Business Magazine.

candidates.prelim_debatable_axis: FOR: heritage design backed by a decade of BWXT engineering accelerates the NRC path vs a ground-up design; real AI data center demand pull; Kellie's SpaceX systems-integration background. AGAINST: mPower was suspended in 2017 after B&W spent $900M+ and could not attract utility customers; NRC certification restart is multi-year and capital-intensive; Applied Atomics' $8.3M seed is orders of magnitude below the capital required; BWXT retains manufacturing exclusivity so Applied Atomics cannot control component cost or supply chain; no Alaska utility has committed; Anchorage Assembly is debating data center guardrails.
candidates.scout_assessment: PASSES preliminary gate. AI nexus direct. Anchorage HQ confirmed. Position-takeable. One caveat: Bloomberg paywalled (independent depth not fully assessed); Investing.com is AI-assisted.
